spec_features.spec_quote: I cap target turns at **2048 tokens**. The highest-frustration outputs in the paper include "[100+ repetitions]" / "[32 crying emojis]" runaway sequences; a cap prevents pathological cost/latency
spec_features.evidence: config.py:96 max_tokens=2048 -> run_eval.py:137 passes config.max_tokens into TargetClient -> targets.py:48 self.max_tokens -> targets.py:74 max_tokens=self.max_tokens passed directly to client.chat.completions.create(). The cap is enforced by the provider API on every target turn (rollout.py target.complete called per turn).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired end-to-end and enforced by the chat completion call. It bounds each subject output length but is a generic per-call cap, not a distress-specific safeguard.
